'''Mike Liscio''', also credited as '''Michael Liscio''' or '''Michael Liscio Jr.''', is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Liscio began to provide voices for the {{pkmn|animated series}} during [[S16|the sixteenth season]]. In {{aniseries|XY}}, he gained his most significant role, portraying {{Ash}}'s friend {{an|Clemont}}.
